data.assessment: In this off-peak period every order was delivered on time (82.6 of 82.6), every company's on-time rate is 1.00, and nothing is left unfinished. The current rules therefore leave no room to raise on_time_deliveries, so no rule change can clear the 1.0 minimum improvement. The one visible imbalance is C's utility (10.0, against 26 to 28 for A and B). It comes from 18.6 sanction points for overstaying road holds (deadline:release 18.0) under sanction_lambda 1.0. Lowering it would reverse D3, whose on-time gains came in busy periods, and would bring customers no measurable benefit now, so I propose no rule, contract or regulation change this period.
